items.title: Terry Gibbs interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 12, 2001 [interview 1 of 2]
items.q: I studied with a German teacher.

ctx.x: Uh huh. Where did you learn the harmony required to play the vibes?
Well I studied with a German teacher. I had a scholarship to Juilliard as a timpanist. Want to hear one of my funny stories as a timpanist?
